title: Configurable progress bins are clipped by a fixed axis range
reasoning: The progress computation explicitly supports ten bins, producing a first point at 10%. The chart always starts its visible x-axis at 15%, hiding that point. Larger bin counts hide additional early-progress observations.
reproduction: Build a progress chart with num_bins=10 and checkpoints numbered 1 through 10 for one problem. Its trace contains x=10, but the axis range is [15, 105].
recommendation: Derive the lower axis bound from the configured bins or show the complete 0–100% progress interval with suitable padding.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No chart tests were supplied; coverage of nondefault bin counts cannot be verified.
suggestedRegressionTest: For several supported bin counts, assert that every generated progress point lies within the chart's visible axis range.
